guide.title: Frosthavn field guide
guide.welcome: Welcome to Frosthavn. K opens your route book and nature notes.
guide.keys: K / Esc: close    1-3 / Left-Right: pages    Up-Down: note    R: record nearby
guide.tooFar: Stand beside a listed landmark before recording it.
guide.already: This observation is already in your notebook.
guide.loop: Fish from the harbor, sell at the blue fish market, and sleep in the red guesthouse. Repair the shed for smoking and drying. Daily orders pay extra for seasonal fish.
guide.goal.Arrival: Walk west along the town lane and enter the red guesthouse. Claim finished quest rewards in the native journal.
guide.goal.catch: Catch and give Ada three fish in one stack. The first-shipment order has no deadline. Requested fish:
guide.goal.Shed: Give Roan one stack of 40 wood. The harbor counter imports wood (15g each); your farm is cheaper. Repairs finish overnight. The guesthouse writing desk forwards equipment mail.
guide.goal.BoatRepair: Give Roan 2 iron bars in one stack. The supplies counter trades 3 seasonal fish for each bar, twice per save (spring/summer capelin, fall cod, winter polar cod). Imported bars cost 1000g; home-mined bars also work. The boat opens the next morning.
guide.goal.FjordVisit: At the harbor's eastern pier, interact with the route sign to visit the fjord.
guide.goal.DeepCatch: Fishing level 4: catch a Greenland halibut at the fjord and give it to Ada.
guide.goal.claim: Open the native quest journal to claim a finished reward and continue the shipment chain.
guide.goal.free: Explore, finish daily fish orders, cook, or fill your nature notebook. The fjord route is open.
guide.goal.start: Visit the town and enter the red guesthouse to begin the first-shipment journey.
guide.fishing.spring: Harbor: capelin and polar cod. Cast from the wooden piers; keep clear of painted ice.
guide.fishing.summer: Harbor: capelin and Atlantic cod. Summer and autumn char live in the tundra stream.
guide.fishing.fall: Harbor: Atlantic cod. Fjord: golden redfish (level 2+) and halibut (level 4+).
guide.fishing.winter: Harbor: polar cod. Cast west from the upper pier into dark open water. Harbor pots can catch snow crab.
guide.return: Homeward: the shuttle post by the eastern town pier takes you to the airstrip. Press B there for your included return. The fjord boat still returns to the harbor.
guide.service: Harbor supplies: rods, bait, coal, repair materials and recipes. Guesthouse desk: forwarded mail. Shared kitchens: guesthouse and community house.
guide.mapLegend: Orange: you are here. Walking paths and boat route; schematic, not to scale.
guide.directions: North from town to tundra; the northern lookout leads to the mountain trail. North to the glacier, east to camp. The tundra bridge also reaches camp. East from town to harbor; the east post shuttles to the airstrip. The upper yellow house is the community house.
guide.boatOpen: Fjord boat open. Use the route post at the east end of the harbor pier. Return from the landing's west notice.
guide.boatClosed: Fjord boat under repair. Complete Roan's wood and iron requests, then sleep. The tundra trail stays open.
guide.observeHelp: Walk to the landmark, open this book, and press R. Notes use your current location and native date; sleep to save them.
guide.site.rock.name: Rock and town
guide.site.rock.where: Town: beside the guide sign on the central waterfront lane.
guide.site.rock.body: Dark bare rock lies between the houses. Small stairs and the main lane connect the doors to the quay. Snow changes the surface, while the underlying rocky coast remains.
guide.site.harbor.name: A working harbor
guide.site.harbor.where: Harbor: upper pier beside the fishing notice.
guide.site.harbor.body: Ropes, fish racks and wooden berths make this a working waterfront. Safe fishing is from shore and piers; a painting of shore ice is never a walking route.
guide.site.ice.name: Ice from the glacier
guide.site.ice.where: Icefjord: the observation platform beside the deep-water notice.
guide.site.ice.body: An iceberg is a floating piece detached from a glacier. Sea ice forms when seawater freezes. Similar colours do not make them the same kind of ice. Observe both from the marked platform.
guide.site.tundra.name: Low-growing tundra
guide.site.tundra.where: Tundra: the northern wooden lookout at the end of the trail.
guide.site.tundra.body: Tundra vegetation stays low. Short growing seasons and cold favour low shrubs, mosses and lichens over tall trees. Follow the trail through the plants; this is not a snowy forest.
guide.site.camp.name: Shelters for a season
guide.site.camp.where: Field camp: follow the western shelter path south to the notice beside the first dome or tent.
guide.site.camp.body: The camp changes with the season: snow-block domes in winter, canvas tents in the other seasons. These are demonstration shelters, not a description of every Arctic home. The red research hut offers an actual bed; the marked trail returns west to the tundra bridge.
guide.changeHelp: The requested fish is out of season. Keep this order if you have stored fish, or change it to three seasonal fish. Reward and next step stay the same. New fish:
guide.changed: Order changed. Give Ada three of the new fish in one stack. No items or money were exchanged.
guide.changeUnavailable: No eligible out-of-season first order. Completed orders and pending rewards stay unchanged.
guide.changeFailed: The order data could not be verified. Your existing order was kept.

flight.boardingOut: Your invitation includes the return. Our transfer takes you to the airport, then north to the snowfield. Bring your curiosity and watch the Arctic light.
flight.boardingHome: Your return is included. You will arrive at the Valley bus stop with your belongings.
flight.hintReturn: B: included return flight | South path: town
flight.phase0: Yueyueniao Airlines / Beyond the familiar fields
flight.skip: Esc / controller B: skip and arrive safely
flight.landed: Welcome to Frosthavn. Follow the marked path south to town; K opens your guide.
flight.needInvitation: Look for Yueyueniao's invitation in your mailbox before checking in.
flight.singlePlayer: Air travel currently supports single-player games.
flight.unavailable: The flight is unavailable. You remain here with your belongings.
start.load: Up / Down: choose save  |  Enter: load  |  Esc: back
guide.airWelcome: Welcome to Frosthavn. Follow the marked path south into town; K opens your guide.
guide.goal.airport: Follow the path south past the airport lamps into town. The red guesthouse stands west of the town lane. B at the airstrip checks in for your included return.
guide.goal.noRod: No rod yet? The harbor supplies counter east of town sells a training rod for 25g. At the counter, Tab enables keyboard selection, arrows choose, Enter buys. You can explore first; the shipment has no deadline.
guide.goal.catchProgress: In your pack: {{count}} / 3. Face open water from a pier, hold C to cast, then press C at the bite. The training rod cannot take bait.
journal.keys: Enter: claim this reward  |  Esc: back to list / close
weekly.locked: Weekly contracts open after the shed repair. Offers refresh on Monday; the team may accept one per week, due Sunday.
weekly.keys: Left/Right: choose | Enter: accept | Esc: close. One team contract each week, due Sunday.
weekly.crate.empty: This is the community fish crate. Accept the guesthouse fish contract on the noticeboard first.
weekly.crate.keys: Arrows: backpack slot   Enter: donate   Esc: confirm and close; donated fish are consumed.
ice.season: This surveyed ice-fishing station opens in winter. Stay on the timber platform.
ice.locked: The fjord boat must be repaired before the ice station can open.
ice.ready: The opening is clear for today. From the end of the timber platform, cast a short distance east into the dark opening. Polar cod; halibut requires fishing level 4. Sea ice is never a footpath.
ice.host: Ask the host to check and clear the opening. Everyone can fish here once it is open.
ice.tool: Hold your pickaxe and interact with this marker to clear the surveyed opening. Repeat the inspection each winter day. Keep both feet on the timber platform.
ice.opened: The surveyed opening is ready. Cast east from the platform; do not step onto sea ice.
sled.season: The dog-team route opens in winter. Marked walking trails remain open in other seasons.
sled.single: Dog-team travel is currently available in single-player. Please use the marked walking trail in multiplayer.
sled.locked: Mira: Help the harbor repair the processing shed first; then we can prepare the winter route together.
sled.tools: Mira: My lashing tool was left beside the parked sled on the mountain trail. Check the station marker there, then bring it to the tundra stop.
sled.toolFound: You found the lashing tool. Return it at the tundra stop.
sled.toolsDone: The equipment yard is in order. Use the tundra, camp or glacier stop to arrange a journey.
sled.supplies: Mira: Thank you. Collect the packed supplies at the field-camp sign and bring them back to the tundra stop.
sled.supplyFound: The packed supplies are in your bag. Bring them to the tundra stop.
sled.repair: Mira: The last job is the stop repair. Bring 20 wood and 5 fiber to the tundra stop for the rail and lashings.
sled.repairConfirm: Use 20 wood and 5 fiber to repair the tundra stop?
sled.trial: Mira: Everything is checked. Take the first route from the tundra stop to the field camp; then all three winter stops will open.
sled.choose: Mira: The team is ready. Where shall we go?
sled.full: Please leave one empty bag slot for the equipment.
sled.unavailable: The route is not ready. You can still return by the marked walking trail.
sled.unlocked: First journey completed. All three winter dog-team stops are open.
sled.item.0.name: Lashing tool
sled.item.0.desc: Mira left it beside the parked sled. Return it at the tundra stop.
sled.item.1.name: Packed trail supplies
sled.item.1.desc: Packed at the field camp. Deliver it to the tundra stop.
